In this masterclass you learn Odisha's regional architectural vocabulary.

Length, level and language are agreed with you. It can be given online or at your venue, as a single session or as part of a series.

What it covers

  • Kalinga vocabulary
  • Bhubaneswar comparison
  • Konark case

How the time is spent

  1. Kalinga vocabulary 30 min

    Rekha deul, pidha deul and temple components.

    You: label elevation

  2. Bhubaneswar comparison 60 min

    Regional forms and building chronology.

    You: temple matrix

  3. Konark case 30 min

    Architectural programme and present conservation.

    You: critical reading

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Distinguish the rekha deul from the pidha deul and name their components.
  • Compare temple forms in Bhubaneswar and place them in building chronology.
  • Read the architectural programme at Konark and its present conservation.
